request.caption: Gentle warm savanna sunset instrumental: a warm kalimba and a nylon-string guitar playing one simple singing melody together in the middle register, a soft marimba answering it between the phrases, warm strings holding long glowing chords, a round plucked acoustic bass walking under the chords, the percussion only a very quiet shaker and fingertip conga far behind everything, soft and sparse, the melody always clearly in front, tender and glowing like the last golden light over the grassland, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, spacious reverb, the full ensemble playing throughout from the first bar, no vocals
